headline: BAE Systems Secures $6 Billion CV90 Combat Vehicle Order from Five European Nations
summary: Finland, Sweden, Norway, Lithuania, and the Netherlands signed a joint agreement to acquire more than 430 CV90 combat vehicles from BAE Systems in a deal valued at $6 billion.
why: BAE Systems is a major multinational defense contractor supplying military equipment and aerospace systems to governments worldwide.

impacts.name: BAE Systems plc
impacts.why: BAE Systems secured a $6 billion joint procurement order for over 430 CV90 combat vehicles.
